sentences.en: Lady Ashton became much alarmed and consulted the family physicians.
sentences.zh: 阿什顿夫人非常担心，于是咨询了家里的医生。

sentences.en: More and more physicians have begun to use the new medicines.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的医生开始使用新的药物。

sentences.en: In addition to being a physician, he was a master pianist.
sentences.zh: 除了是一名内科医生外，他还是一位钢琴大师。

senses.zh: 医生，内科医生,<口>医学博士,（精神创伤的）医治者，抚慰者
